subject: english
question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: He leaned against that same stone column, thinking, serching in his mind, felling acutely.
He leaned aganst that same stone column, thinking, searching in his mind, feeling acutely.
He leened against that same stone column, thinking, searching in his mind, feeling acutely.
He leaned against that same stone column, thinking, searching in his mind, feeling acutely.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"serching"** is a misspelling of the correct word ***"searching"*,** which means to look for or seek something. (खोज करना)

 
 
• **Example: **She was **searching **for her lost keys all morning.
 
 
 
• **"Feeling"** is the correct spelling, which means experiencing emotions or sensations. (महसूस करना)
 
 
• **Example: **He was **feeling** happy after receiving the good news.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the correct answer is the one with all words spelled correctly: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: serching** (खोजना): The correct spelling is "searching".

 
 
• **Example:** She was searching for her lost book in the library.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: aganst** (के खिलाफ): The correct spelling is "against".
 
 
• **Example: **He stood against the wall, waiting for his friend.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: leened** (टेक लगाया): The correct spelling is "leaned".
 
 
• **Example:** She leaned on the table while thinking deeply.
